summary: Blue Hill Mountain, Hancock Co., ME: 60 ft steel Aermotor; site picked 1947, built 1949 per listing; dismantled 2005 at landowner's request; site today undescribed.

facts.status_note: Dismantled in 2005 at the landowner's request; no source describes what remains on the summit

events.note: Maine Forest Service chose the summit as a fire lookout site
Build year in the Maine lookout listing (60 ft steel Aermotor); the lookout-history site gives 1947 for a steel tower
Tower dismantled; removed at the landowner's request
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register, September 15, 2008

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Maine Forest Service picked the site in 1947; the Maine lookout listing gives 1949 as the build year; the lookout-history site gives 1947 for a steel tower. The story reports both dates and does not choose one.

sources.title: Blue Hill Mountain fire tower, Blue Hill, ca. 1950

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: no source found on staffing, fires, access or what remains on the site today. Build year conflicts (1947 vs 1949) and both are reported. Brief record status 'gone' is correct; no corrections. The ipage.com state listing is attributed to the Forest Fire Lookout Association by inference (it matches the firelookout.org Maine list). No photos added; image URLs were not verified.
